summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) filed a Form 6-K announcing its intention to purchase up to 30 million common shares for cancellation under a normal course issuer bid (NCIB), representing ~3.3% of outstanding shares as of April 30, 2026. The bid is subject to TSX approval, with purchases on TSX, alternative Canadian trading systems, or NYSE at market prices. The previous NCIB (20 million shares) expired May 25, 2026. No premium, fixed price, or definitive timetable is set. The bid provides capital management flexibility. Watch for TSX acceptance and actual purchase pace; no risk-arbitrage angle as this is an open-market buyback.
